title: 第3章 魔法伊艾克丝咖喱棒第4章 不擅骑术
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第3章魔法，伊艾克丝咖喱棒
哐当——
突然一阵头痛惊醒了姆莉，她睁开了双眼，却发现面前一片漆黑，耳畔环绕着女人们的哽咽声，还有车轮碾过地面的声音。
怎么回事？我还在做梦吗？姆莉心中惊骇，尝试活动了两下，发现自己的手脚动弹不得。
她被人绑架了！
“呜！呜呜呜？呜呜呜……”她试着说话，却发现嘴巴似乎被布条之类的东西封住，张口只能发出含糊的呜呜声。
那一刻，姆莉忽然冷静下来。感受着黑暗的环境、倾听其他人的哭声、用肌肤感受四周的环境。
这似乎是一个半封闭的车厢内。
她想到了故事里的桥段，漂亮女子遭遇劫匪绑架，英勇帅气的勇者从天而降来了一场华丽的英雄救美。
她编写过类似的桥段，可从未料想自己竟然有一天会成为被绑架的人。
可她不是在旅店睡觉吗？怎么会忽然被人绑架呢？自己又是怎么被人盯上的？
不管了，先解除束缚再说，我记得解缚魔法应该是……
“呜呜呜呜，呜呜，呜呜，呜呜呜……”姆莉开始有节奏的发出呜呜声，而她的身体四周也泛起了漂亮的彩色光点。
啪~捆住双臂的绳子被解开，得以自由活动的姆莉自己拿下了遮住双眼的布条，这才得以看清自己的处境。
这里的确是一个半封闭的空间——一个半人高且被大布盖住的木笼，只有临近车尾的布料开了缝，给人透气。
姆莉再看四周，都是一些女性，下至孩童上至妇女，无一不是被遮目捂口束在这里。
对了，之前酒馆里有人提到过妇女失踪，应该就是这伙人了。
忽然间，车厢剧烈跳动了一下，车厢内的众人没有坐稳，几乎都撞到了脑袋。一时间，吃痛者发出了惊慌与恐惧的呜呜声。
“嘶——哈~”姆莉疼得双手抱头，不敢发出太大的动静，生怕惊动了这伙人贩。
这份疼痛来的熟悉，她刚刚肯定也是这样撞到了脑袋。
“唉啊啊啊！吵死啦！”忽然一道不耐烦的声音从车厢前面传来，虽然很微弱，但还是被姆莉从这复杂的环境中捕捉到了。
她几乎在第一时间贴到了边缘，试图凑近距离让自己听得更清楚些。
“习惯习惯就习惯啦~这条破路就是这样，每次都会惊醒车厢里的货物。”这道声音也是男声，但相对纤细，听声音就给人一种奸诈的感觉。
“习惯什么？你说话太绕了。”不耐烦的声音再次出现，又在下一刻抱怨起了这份活，“昨晚让那条傻狗耍了大几个小时，我现在烦着呢。”
“可能是狗鼻子用多了，坏了，以前不那样的。”
“兜兜转转了好几圈，抓来的人越来越少，再这样下去老大要骂人的！啧，下次换个养狗的。”
狗？什么狗？姆莉困惑，难道这些人贩子是用狗来寻找绑架目标的？
如果用狗，就需要事先留下标记，一般是气味……
思索间，姆莉脑中闪过了唐赠送浓云抹的画面，顿时惊得睁大了眼睛。
浓云抹的气味覆盖性强，长时间不散，犬类很容易分辨！
那个叫唐的家伙经常送花向女人们告白，每一次被拒绝后都会送花赔礼，想必也是类似于浓云抹之类的花束吧？
店长说他每次购花都不一样，很有可能就是想用这种方式摆脱嫌疑……不会错，唐根本就不是一个疯子，他是一个人贩子！
第3章魔法，伊艾克丝咖喱棒
接下来要怎么做？将计就计还是趁机用魔法开锁带人逃走？我的魔法不强，恐怕不是人贩的对手啊！
姆莉紧张地咬着指甲，苦恼着接下来该如何是好。

Chapter 3 Magic, Ix Curry Sticks
Clang——
A sudden headache woke up Mli. She opened her eyes, only to find darkness in front of her. Her ears were surrounded by the choking sounds of women and the sound of wheels rolling over the ground.
What's going on? Am I still dreaming? Muli was horrified and tried to move twice, but found that she could not move her hands and feet.
She's been kidnapped!
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" She tried to speak, but found that her mouth seemed to be sealed with a piece of cloth, and she could only make a vague whine when she opened her mouth.
At that moment, Mli suddenly calmed down. Feel the darkness, listen to the cries of others, and feel your surroundings with your skin.
This appears to be a semi-enclosed compartment.
She thought of the scene in the story, where a beautiful woman was kidnapped by robbers, and a brave and handsome man descended from the sky to perform a magnificent heroic rescue.
She had written similar plots, but she never imagined that one day she would become a kidnapped person.
But isn't she sleeping in the hotel? Why was he suddenly kidnapped? How did he get targeted?
No matter, let’s untie the bond first. I remember that unbinding magic should be...
"Woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo-ooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooaoss.
Snap~ The rope binding her arms was untied, and Mli, ​​who was able to move freely, took off the cloth strips covering her eyes, and then she was able to see her situation clearly.
This is indeed a semi-enclosed space - a wooden cage half a person's height covered by a large cloth. Only the cloth near the rear of the car is slit to allow ventilation.
Muli looked around and saw women, ranging from children to women, all of whom were bound here with their eyes covered and their mouths covered.
By the way, someone in the tavern mentioned that women were missing before, and it should be this group of people.
"Bang——"
Suddenly, the carriage jumped violently, and everyone in the carriage was not able to sit still, and almost all of them hit their heads. For a moment, the pain-eater let out a whine of panic and fear.
"Hiss-ha~" Mu Li held her head in both hands in pain, not daring to make too much noise for fear of alarming the traffickers.
This pain was familiar, she must have hit her head like this just now.
"Ahhhh! It's so noisy!" Suddenly an impatient voice came from the front of the carriage. Although it was very weak, it was still captured by Muli from this complicated environment.
She almost pressed to the edge immediately, trying to get closer so that she could hear it more clearly.
"You just get used to it~ This broken road is like this. It will wake up the goods in the carriage every time." This voice is also a male voice, but it is relatively thin, and the sound gives people a treacherous feeling.
"What are you used to? You talk too convolutedly." The impatient voice appeared again, and complained about the job the next moment, "I let that stupid dog play for several hours last night, and now I'm annoyed."
"Maybe the dog's nose has been damaged due to too much use. It wasn't like that before."
"After going around in circles for several times, the number of people caught is getting less and less. If this continues, the boss will scold me! Tsk, let's find a dog owner next time."
Dog? What dog? Muli was confused. Do these human traffickers use dogs to find kidnapping targets?
If you use a dog, you need to leave a mark in advance, usually a scent...
While thinking about it, the image of Tang giving Nongyun Momo flashed through her mind, and her eyes widened in shock.
The scent of Nong Yun Mo has strong coverage and lasts for a long time, making it easy for dogs to distinguish!
That guy named Tang often sent flowers to confess his love to women. Every time he was rejected, he would send flowers to apologize. It must be similar to a bouquet like Nongyunmo, right?
The store manager said that every time he bought flowers, they were different. He probably wanted to get rid of suspicion in this way... You were right, Tang was not a madman at all, he was a human trafficker!
Chapter 3 Magic, Ix Curry Sticks
What to do next? Will you use the trick or take the opportunity to use magic to unlock the door and lead people to escape? My magic is not strong, I’m afraid I’m no match for human traffickers!
Muri bit her nails nervously, wondering what to do next.
